metadata.title: Photometric Study of Variable Stars in the Open Cluster NGC6866

notes: No star meets either contribution category. The closest potential false positive is V10: the authors classify it as a “new high-velocity star” (T:p12-b4) and a definite field star (T:p11-b1), but they give only a tangential-velocity greater-than-100 km/s criterion for high-velocity stars and never state or establish that V10 is unbound from the Milky Way. Non-membership in the open cluster is likewise not Galactic unboundedness.
